turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and very satisfying. How is your roommate Sam doing? Have they been keeping busy too?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's always nice to catch up when life gets busy. Have you had any free time to get out for some rock climbing lately, or has work taken over your week?

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect way to decompress. I hope the rest of your client calls go smoothly this afternoon!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'm hoping to unwind with some guitar practice later tonight if I finish up work at a decent hour. Have a great rest of your day!
